texts.zh:
创建一支防卫星海帝国的无敌舰队已经被签署成为法令。新建立的帝国海军将从整个帝国的成员国中征召船员和后勤队伍，但其大部分军官仍由[gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural]组成。

这一舰队直接听令于[gal_emperor.GetName]，所有的新兵将被要求宣誓效忠[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]。
texts.en:
The creation of a grand fleet for the defense of the Galactic Imperium has been signed into law. This new Imperial Armada will conscript its ship crews and support personnel from within all the members of the Imperium, but a majority of its officer corps will consist of [gal_emperor.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

The Armada shall be under the direct control of the [gal_emperor.GetName], and all new conscripts will be required to swear an oath of allegiance to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

label.zh: 我们的[root.GetIndividualName]军官将会对他们保持监管。
label.en: Our [root.GetIndividualName] officers will keep them in check.
It is a time of change.

texts.zh:
第一帝国军团现在正在[gal_emperor.GetName]上征召组建。这支精英地面部队具有征募帝国任何一名公民成为士兵的权力。许多军事院校已经完成了对可靠人选的寻找，并且据信，只要发现了格外适任者，任何一位公民哪怕是儿童也会被招募。

从残暴的训练科目和近乎对人格打碎重构的深度精神塑造中幸存下来的人才能顺利毕业成为帝国军团士兵。他们可靠的战斗技巧，无懈可击的纪律和对[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]近乎狂热的忠诚使得他们成为整个星系中最强有力的突击队。
texts.en:
The first Imperial Legions are now being assembled in the [gal_emperor.GetName]. This elite ground force has the legal authority to conscript citizens from all members of the Imperium. Many military academies are already being scouted for promising candidates, and there are reports that civilians - even children - are drafted if found to be unusually capable.

Those who survive the brutal training program and its extensive mental conditioning - in which their personalities are largely rebuilt from scratch - graduate as Imperial Legionnaires. Their formidable fighting skills, unnerving discipline, and fanatic loyalty to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] make them some of the finest assault troops in the galaxy.

texts.zh:
隶属于帝国安全总局的特工正在逐渐部署到帝国境内的所有星球，他们在表面上会协助当地执法部门维护治安，同时暗地里会调查严重犯罪并施加制裁。

帝安局的另一个职能——通过帝国司法部直接向[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]负责——是铲除“恐怖分子、叛党和分离主义者”，这些人会在暗地里破坏帝国的稳定和统一。
texts.en:
Agents from the Imperial Security Directorate are in the process of deploying to worlds all over the Imperium, where they will ostensibly aid local law enforcement agencies in the investigation and prosecution of serious crimes.

Another function of the ISD, which reports only to the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] through the Imperial Ministry of Justice, is to root out "terrorists, rebels, and seditionists" who threaten to undermine the stability of the Imperium.

label.zh: 无人能逃过帝国的正义的制裁。

note.zh: 游戏会按政体显示统治者的头衔。

texts.zh:
星海帝国的暴君妄想将自身的意志强加于我们身上！在他们[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的赐福之下，帝国参议院已经通过了一项议案，指定我们作为一场大远征的目标。

除非我们可以抵挡住接踵而至的入侵，否则我们就要被迫并入星海帝国，屈服于[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的淫威之下。
texts.en:
The tyrants of the Galactic Imperium seek to impose their will on us! With the blessing of their [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], the Imperial Senate has passed a resolution that makes us the target of an Imperial Crusade.

Unless we can somehow defeat this impending invasion, we will be forced into the Imperium and subordinated to the whims of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle].

label.zh: 接下来的战斗将决定我们的命运。
label.en: The coming battles will decide our future.

texts.zh: 随着针对[crusade_target.GetName]的大远征启动，强大的舰队在星海帝国的全境开始动员起来。对于旁观者而言，看上去任何外部势力想要抗衡帝国的联合舰队力量都无异于痴人说梦，但是接下来的战斗才会决定最终的结果。
texts.en: Powerful fleets are mobilizing all across the Galactic Imperium as the great crusade against the [crusade_target.GetName] begins. To many observers, it seems unfathomable that any outside power could hope to prevail against the combined might of the Imperium, but the coming battles will determine the outcome.

texts.zh: 随着针对[crusade_target.GetName]的大远征启动，强大的舰队在星海帝国的全境开始动员起来。这个失落帝国已经延续了近千年，然而[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]却满怀自信，认为帝国的联合舰队力量能够让它在年轻种族面前俯首称臣。
texts.en: Powerful fleets are mobilizing all across the Galactic Imperium as the great crusade against the [crusade_target.GetName] begins. This Fallen Empire has endured for millennia, yet the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] seems confident that the combined might of the Imperium will be enough to finally bring it under the heel of the younger races.

[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]出于感激，诏令参议院将帝国特许经营权授予[charter_corp.GetName]。这给予他们特殊权力，用以在帝国全境的各处行星上建立分部，而不用和行星的所属国签订商贸协定。

我们可以料想到，这个寰宇企业马上也会在我们下辖的世界上开设分部，建立帝国特许口岸，而我们的司法权在此地不再有效。看来[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]为了拉动经济增长打造了一台强劲的引擎。
texts.en:
After having curried favor with the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], [charter_corp.GetName] has now been granted an Imperial Charter by the Senate. This gives them special dispensation to open branch offices on planets all over the Imperium, regardless of whether they have a commercial pact with the owner.

We can expect the megacorporation to establish Imperial Concession Ports in their branch offices on our worlds soon, where we will have no jurisdiction. It would seem the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] has acquired a powerful new engine of economic growth.

# 帝国议会的法案与干预 / Imperial laws and interventions

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/nemesis_emperor_events.txt, common/resolutions/01_resolutions_nemesis.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt · DLC：Nemesis · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

这些事件各自挂在一个帝国决议通过时（common/resolutions/01_resolutions_nemesis.txt）：帝国舰队 resolution_emperor_imperial_armada（:3529，事件在 3559）、帝国军团 resolution_emperor_imperial_legions（:3861，3889）、帝国安全局 resolution_emperor_isd（:4324，4353）、帝国特许状（:4450-4465）、帝国远征 resolution_galactic_empire_imperial_crusade（:3214，3314）、帝国和平 resolution_emperor_pax_galactica（:5797，5836）；皇帝保护成员事件由 on_war_beginning（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2602-2608）触发。
Each event is attached to its resolution being passed; the defence event runs when a war begins.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- emperor.50 “帝国舰队”：新舰队从各成员国征召船员，军官主要来自皇帝的物种；三种回应取决于是否皇帝、同种族等。 Armada founded.
- emperor.55 “军团成立”：帝国军团可以向所有成员征兵。 Legions founded.
- emperor.70 “帝国安全局”：特工部署到各成员国。 ISD founded.
- emperor.60 “帝国特许状”：某公司获得特许状，可在全帝国开办分公司（emperor.61-65 为特许港口的隐藏计数）。 Charter granted.
- emperor.350 / 351 “帝国向我们进军”/“帝国远征开始”：被选为远征目标者（350）与其他国家（351，三种回应）。 Crusade declared.
- emperor.360 “帝国和平”：成员国之间的战争被立即终止。 Pax Galactica.
- emperor.370（隐藏，on_war_beginning）：非成员国攻击成员国的战争领袖时，10 天后问皇帝 → emperor.371：a 保卫成员（帝国权威 +20，皇帝加入防御方，受害方得 372 “皇帝提供支持”，攻击方得 373 “皇帝介入！”）/ b 抛弃成员（权威 −20，受害方得 374 “皇帝宣布中立”）。
  The emperor is asked to defend a member (371): defend (372 / 373) or abandon (374).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 371 的 a、b 互斥；各法案事件互相独立。 371's options are exclusive; laws are independent.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 每个法案需要对应决议通过；皇帝保护成员事件要求攻击方不是共同体成员、且战争中没有皇帝参战。 Each needs its resolution; 370 needs a non-member attacker.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：emperor.50-70、350-374 的触发与调用点（决议与 on_war_beginning）。
- 更正 Corrections：emperor.495（测试事件，trigger = always = no）曾是“特许状”的根，真实触发是帝国特许状决议；十一个单页故事并为一个。
  The test event 495 was the old root of the charter story; the real trigger is the charter resolution.
